headline: Against the Odds, Five Cheetah Cubs Thrive at Prague Zoo
meta_description: Five cheetah cubs born during storms at Prague Zoo have survived their mother's illness and are now thriving, offering hope for the critically endangered speci…
summary_short: Five cheetah cubs born in June at Prague Zoo have survived torrential storms and their mother's illness, bringing hope for a species with fewer than 7,000 left in the wi…
body:
Five cheetah cubs born on June 18 at Prague Zoo have defied difficult odds to emerge healthy and lively, offering a rare glimmer of hope for one of the world's most endangered big cats. The quintuplets—four males and one female—faced a brutal start: their mother, Daenerys, chose to give birth in an outdoor enclosure just as strong storms battered Prague. Yet despite her inexperience, she proved a devoted protector, licking water from the cubs' fluffy fur to keep them dry through torrential rains. When Daenerys later suffered an intestinal infection in August, the young cubs faced another threat. Today, all five are thriving, and zoo curator Pavel Brandl confirmed they look vibrant and healthy.

The cubs' survival matters far beyond Prague. With fewer than 7,000 cheetahs estimated to remain in the wild, conservationists regard every cub as irreplaceable to the species' survival. Cheetahs face relentless pressure from habitat loss and poaching, and in nature, infant mortality rates remain dangerously high due to predators and diseases like pneumonia. The Prague Zoo's breeding program represents one of humanity's last chances to preserve this remarkable animal—the fastest land creature on Earth, capable of reaching speeds between 70 and 75 mph.

Brandl cautioned that the cubs have not yet crossed the finish line. "It might take a year before it's clear that they will survive the crucial period after their birth," he noted. Still, watching five vulnerable cubs weather storms, illness, and inexperience to flourish reminds us that resilience—both in nature and in dedicated human care—can prevail even when extinction looms.
quick_facts: Five cheetah cubs born June 18 at Prague Zoo
Mother Daenerys protected them through torrential storms
Cubs survived mother's intestinal infection in August
Fewer than 7,000 cheetahs remain in the wild
